parsed_json.up: Select molecule_chembl_id, assay_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, target_type, tax_id, standard_type, pchembl_value from activity rows for target CHEMBL260. Join target_dictionary on assay tid, compound_structures on activity molregno, and assays on assay_id. Filter to target_type SINGLE PROTEIN, tax_id 9606, standard_type IC50, standard_relation '=', and pchembl_value not null. Do not deduplicate. Sort by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id.
